user.title: Phomemo Q30
user.description: Pick the printer from the list, or type its Bluetooth address (e.g. AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF). Switch the printer on and keep it near Home Assistant.

data_description.label_width_mm: The long side of the label, in the direction the paper comes out of the printer. E.g. 28.
data_description.label_height_mm: The short side of the label, across the paper. E.g. 12.
data_description.margin_x_mm: Empty space at both ends of the label. Increase it if text is cut off at the ends.
data_description.margin_y_mm: Empty space along the two long edges. Increase it if text is cut off at the sides.
data_description.address: If the list is full of other devices, just type the printer's address.
